02: Fonts fixed; a message sent to the mock agent streams into the chat.
03: Every status bucket seeded; markdown in replies; phone tab bar.
04: Plan approvals show Review; tablet landscape docks the list.
05: Source control: branch card with pull/push, commit box, changed files, split/unified diff.
06: Terminals: list per checkout, new/kill, real PTY rendered with xterm in the Bracket palette.
07: Inbox (needs you / failures / finished, detail with permission card and context), ⌘K command palette, phone More sheet with every tool.
08: Settings: You / Agents / Host navigation; Automation, Tools & prompts, Providers, Overview, Appearance and Shortcuts pages read and write the daemon's config.json live.
09: New session (⌘N, + in the list, or home's Ask box): project, worktree vs local checkout, base branch, provider / model / mode from the host's provider snapshot. Creates a real agent and opens it. Composer gets Stop while a turn runs; chat header gets Archive.
